attributes.title: Project Manager Telecommunications
attributes.description:
• At least 3 years of relevant project management experience in telecommunications or technology.
  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Advanced English, both written and spoken, for daily communication in professional and technical environments.
  • Solid knowledge of IP networking, cloud computing, and data center infrastructure.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and objectives.
  • Experience planning project work, preparing budgets, allocating resources, and coordinating subcontractors.
  • Hands-on experience with Budget Management, Resource Allocation, Subcontractor Management, Client Management.
attributes.projects: We are seeking a Project Manager to lead telecommunications and information technology projects from planning through delivery. This role owns project execution, ensuring that client requirements, quality standards, budgets, and timelines are met. You will serve as the primary point of contact between clients and technical, commercial, and operational teams. You will coordinate resources, subcontractors, and implementations while addressing client needs and project risks. The role also contributes to revenue and billing objectives by maintaining delivery commitments, identifying deviations early, and taking corrective action. Strong English communication is required for daily interaction in professional and technical environments.
attributes.functions:
• Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery, ensuring compliance with objectives, budgets, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate project implementation activities between clients and internal technical, commercial, and operational teams.
  • Define project objectives and scope with clients, addressing their needs, requirements, and concerns.
  • Act as the primary liaison between clients and internal teams, maintaining effective communication throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Prepare work plans and budgets, manage resource allocation, and coordinate subcontractors.
  • Monitor implementation progress, identify deviations, and establish corrective actions.
  • Maintain client satisfaction and ensure fulfillment of project commitm

attributes.projects: We're looking for a Partnerships & Campaign Manager to join our growing team and help identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships. This is an excellent opportunity to build a career in mobile marketing and ad tech while working with international partners. You'll support the growth of our partner network, manage campaign activity, and help ensure campaigns are running smoothly and efficiently. This role requires someone who is proactive, highly organized, analytical, and exceptionally detail-oriented.
